english: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\lPOKéMON and the family.

english: I left the major port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\pLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\lbeautiful sea--that's happiness, too.
